items.example: Silent disco sounds fun. Shall we try it?
items.mnemonic: Прохожий шёл и предлагает — Shall we try it, попробуем.

items.idiom: How about going to the theatre?
items.example: How about going to the theatre on Saturday?
items.mnemonic: Друзья в тереме зовут в театр — How about going to the theatre.

items.example: Blind date cinema? That doesn't sound very good.
items.mnemonic: Критик вырубил саунд — that doesn't sound good, звучит не очень.

items.idiom: They give us our money back
items.example: If we don't like the film, they give us our money back.
items.mnemonic: Кассир трясёт мани — they give money back, вернут деньги.

items.example: Theatre in the evening and museum in the afternoon? Sounds great.
items.mnemonic: Диджей врубил саундтрек — Sounds great, звучит отлично.

items.example: Let me see. Dinner in the dark?
items.mnemonic: Гости с дыней ужинают в темноте — Dinner in the dark.

items.example: You go with a small group and meditate for an hour.
items.mnemonic: Медуза медитирует час — meditate for an hour.
